review: Independent content and collector review for sensor/data modules
content_result: No material overstatement or contradiction found in the reviewed pages. Sample/current deployment boundaries, synthetic versus physical timing, local versus remote inference, K60 conditions, MCU/host processing and RAM/file persistence limits are retained.
source_checks: uploader protocol and local storage reports

privacy_scan.scope: 51 explicitly cited .txt reports only; no raw account responses, login state or credentials were read
patterns: literal long identifier in account/device/session route

issues.claim: Collector can be reused to refresh sanitized report snapshots, but current redaction only catches unquoted camelCase identifier keys and selected token encodings.
issues.evidence: Synthetic examples {"deviceId":"SYNTHETIC_DEVICE_0001"}, {"refresh_token":"SYNTHETIC_REFRESH_0001"}, and /v1/devices/SYNTHETIC_DEVICE_0001/live do not match the identifier redactor. There is no opaque password/refresh-token assignment redactor. The current 51 cited reports had zero matches of these suspect shapes, so this is a future-refresh gap rather than a detected current leak.
issues.correction: Extend the reusable redaction function to match quoted camelCase/snake_case identity and credential keys and literal identity path segments; preserve explicit placeholders. Add a small synthetic check for these shapes, and retain the report allowlist/manual selection boundary.

not_checked: full semantics of other agents module pages
original target execution or hardware behavior
